findings.evidence: recordHeartbeat method now declares @Transactional(isolation = Isolation.READ_COMMITTED) at the outermost transactional boundary (line 85). The nested call to findMostRecent in enforceRetryGate (line 89 -> 103) uses Spring's default REQUIRED propagation, inheriting the parent isolation level rather than having its own ignored. Comment at lines 78-84 explains the design decision. RetryRequestRepository.findMostRecent no longer declares isolation level (line 26 has only @Query), with comment at lines 19-25 directing to the actual enforcement point.
findings.why_it_matters: Phase 9 Design Constraint Step 6 requires READ_COMMITTED isolation when checking RetryRequest status during exam start (recordHeartbeat), to ensure the check reflects the most recently committed approval state, not a stale snapshot. Nested @Transactional isolation levels are silently ignored by Spring when joining an already-open transaction; only the outermost boundary's isolation level applies. The fix ensures the requirement is actually enforced.
